content.comment_body: Device model: [article_no] [product_name] version: [version_no] Good morning! Is it possible to set a password in the program so that it cannot be copied to an SD card or a computer without first entering the password? Thanks & regards! [user_name]
Please refer to the attached file. You can download the complete manual from here: [document]

Thanks for your reply! However, when I transfer the program from my computer to the PLC via Ethernet cable and then insert the SD card into the [product_name], the program is copied without any password prompt. Moving the SD card to another device allows the program to be copied as well. Additionally, the password is only requested when modifying parameters while the program is not running, which is problematic since it creates parameters that can't be set. Is there a way to prevent the program from being copied from the PLC to the SD card without first entering the password?

I tested the password protection for the program. As you described, the program can be saved onto the SD card without issues. After that, I deleted the program and password in the [product_name] via software. The device wouldn't start and displayed 'empty program.' Only after cycling the power, the [product_name] loaded the program from the SD card and started again. The password protection became active again.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are questioning the effectiveness of current password protection on [product_name] devices. The system only prompts for a password during modification of the program, not when copying or transferring files, which leaves room for unauthorized access and distribution. This exposes a shortcoming in access control compared to user expectations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect robust password restrictions to be enforced whenever copying or transferring a [product_name] program to an SD card or computer, not just during modifications. They want to prevent unauthorized copying without first entering the required password.
